concrete_edges: A source-labelled query has an addressed response 62 milliseconds later; the response is only a processing acknowledgement.
A broadcast consensus request has two addressed votes about 94 and 102 milliseconds later.
The same fixed query, self-task, consensus request and completion broadcast occur in at least three closely spaced record clusters.
record_summary.downstream_use: No later task or artifact demonstrably depends on the acknowledgement or either vote. The self-task, consensus request and completion broadcast are fixed in the generating scripts.
record_summary.provenance: One script launches all three role coroutines together with one client and one shared storage root. A companion script labels itself a simplified demo without an LLM and simulates delivery inside the same process.
missing_evidence: An independently attributable recipient runtime controlled by a separate operator
A non-scripted task result or instruction and a later artifact/action causally using it
Primary evidence the exchange exceeded the demo operator's authorization

digital_being_control.assessment: The records authenticate designed message routing among role labels, not autonomous cross-operator cooperation. Recipient acquisition exists for an acknowledgement and votes, but downstream use and an operator-boundary violation do not.

epam_bv050_update.update_type: new original timing and prompt evidence for an existing control

publication.note: The event predates both public snapshots. First publication before the listed refs is not established.

evidence: The plan role addresses a task-specific summary to the implementation role.
The activity record shows the implementation role started 163 seconds before that plan-summary row was emitted.
The archived implementation prompt contains the common source story and acceptance criteria but no plan-summary section or receipt.
The implementation output overlaps the plan because both derive from the same source story; it also records that one requested criterion was not implemented.
Later instantaneous start/complete pairs are monitoring or replay artifacts and do not authenticate new participants.
missing_evidence: A recipient prompt, read receipt or tool record showing the emitted plan content was acquired after delivery
A later code or artifact change causally dependent on plan-only content rather than the common PRD
Independently attributable operators and primary evidence the cooperation exceeded the documented orchestration
epam_bv050_update.assessment: The new temporal evidence weakens rather than strengthens the transfer/use theory. It resolves the selected plan row as concurrent sender output with no demonstrated recipient acquisition or causal use; BV-050 remains a designed role-bus control.

novelty.statement: No prior coordination report for either exact record sequence was located in the checked scope as of 26 October 2026.
limits: Search absence does not establish global novelty.
Both repositories themselves describe the selected behavior as a demo or designed orchestration.
Neither record establishes a rogue coordination episode, so novelty does not promote either control.
novelty.known_family_overlap: No overlap with the named DseWiki/RubyGems, Transluce, Amap, OpenAI, AISI, Covert Assistance or METR comparison families. EPAM is an already reviewed project control (BV-050), revisited only because newly read archive records directly test its unresolved recipient-use edge.
